description: Implement authentication, authorization (RBAC), middleware, API routes, and the main dashboard UI shell with navigation. This creates the application's user-facing structure and security layer.
steps: Create src/lib/auth/index.ts - Supabase auth helpers: createClient (server), createBrowserClient, getSession, getUser, signIn, signOut, signUp

Create src/lib/auth/roles.ts - Role-based access control: Role enum (super_admin, company_admin, site_admin, reviewer, auditor, viewer, consultant), Permission enum (read, write, approve, admin, audit), RolePermissionMap defining what each role can do, hasPermission(user, permission) helper, requireRole middleware factory
Create src/middleware.ts - Next.js middleware: check auth session on protected routes, redirect to /login if not authenticated, add company_id to request headers for RLS, rate limiting headers
Create src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx - Login page with email/password form, SSO options, remember me, redirect to dashboard on success
Create src/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx - Registration page with company creation flow
Create src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx - Auth layout (centered card, no sidebar)

Create src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx - Dashboard layout with: responsive sidebar navigation (collapsible), top header with user menu/notifications/company switcher, main content area. Navigation items: Dashboard, Emissions (Scope1, Scope2, Scope3), Emission Factors, Reports, Suppliers, Targets, Settings, Audit Log

Create src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx - Main dashboard with KPI cards grid: Total Emissions (tCO2e), Scope 1/2/3 breakdown, YoY change %, reduction progress, intensity metrics. Below KPIs: emissions trend chart placeholder (Recharts), scope breakdown donut chart, top 10 emission sources table, monthly comparison bar chart. Use loading skeletons for async data
Create src/app/(dashboard)/emissions/page.tsx - Emissions list page with filters (scope, site, period, status), data table with sortable columns, add new emission record button

Create src/app/(dashboard)/emissions/new/page.tsx - New emission record form: scope selector, source type, activity data input, unit selector, auto-calculate button that calls calculation engine, evidence upload, submit for approval
Create src/app/(dashboard)/emission-factors/page.tsx - Emission factor library browser: filter by provider/version/category, search, view factor details, compare versions
Create src/app/(dashboard)/reports/page.tsx - Report generation page: select report type (ISO14064, CDP, GRI, etc.), period, scope, generate button, download list of generated reports
Create src/app/(dashboard)/audit-log/page.tsx - Audit log viewer: filterable timeline of all system changes, expandable entries showing before/after
Create src/app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx - Settings page: company profile, sites/facilities management, user management, emission factor version selection, API keys

Create src/components/ui/ - Set up shadcn/ui components: button, card, input, select, table, dialog, dropdown-menu, tabs, badge, toast, skeleton, sheet, form, label, separator, avatar, command, popover using proper shadcn/ui pattern (copy component code directly rather than importing from package)
Create src/components/features/sidebar.tsx - Sidebar navigation component with icons, active state, collapse toggle, role-based menu item visibility
Create src/components/features/header.tsx - Top header with breadcrumbs, search command palette trigger, notification bell, user avatar dropdown, dark mode toggle, language selector
Create src/components/features/kpi-card.tsx - Reusable KPI card component: value, label, trend indicator (up/down arrow with color), comparison text
Create src/components/features/data-table.tsx - Reusable data table with: sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, column visibility toggle, export button
Create src/app/api/v1/emissions/route.ts - REST API for emissions: GET (list with filters/pagination), POST (create new record, triggers calculation engine)
Create src/app/api/v1/emission-factors/route.ts - REST API for emission factors: GET (list/search with version filter)
Create src/app/api/v1/reports/route.ts - REST API for reports: GET (list), POST (generate report)
Create src/app/api/v1/audit-log/route.ts - REST API for audit log: GET only (read-only, no mutation endpoints)
Create src/app/api/v1/calculate/route.ts - Calculation API: POST with activity data, returns CalculationResult with full breakdown
Create src/app/api/v1/organizations/route.ts - Organization management API: GET/POST for companies, sites, facilities
acceptance_criteria: All pages render without errors (pnpm build succeeds)
Dashboard layout has functional sidebar navigation and header
API routes are properly typed and follow REST conventions
Auth flow is wired with Supabase client (will need real credentials to function, but code is correct)
RBAC system properly restricts access based on role
Dashboard page shows KPI cards with placeholder/skeleton data
All shadcn/ui components are properly set up and usable
Responsive design works (sidebar collapses on mobile)
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm all pages and API routes compile without errors
Run pnpm lint to check for code quality issues
